non-dynamic attribute throws; with(sign.wrap(entity.getAttribute(attribute))): the entry is built before the add
four passes over the list (ADD_VALUE, ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE, ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL through the invoker, then sanitizeValue), each skipping entries with a null value
declared methods: only <init>, with(Signed) and applyTo(D) touch the private list (the other applyTo / relativeTo forms call applyTo(D))
the mod's invoker of AttributeInstance.getModifiersOrEmpty, the only collection read the fast path makes

puffish_attributes_empty_modifier_fast_p.conversion: Cancellable @Inject at the HEAD of DynamicModificationImpl.applyTo(double): when no entry has an ADD_VALUE, ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE or ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL modifier (each instance's modifier map read first through the accessor PuffishModifierMapAccessor, a modifier there ends the test; then the three operation sets through the mod's own invoker, what its passes read) the answer is the sanitizeValue chain alone, the value the original's four passes compute then; otherwise the original. Entries with a null instance are skipped as the passes skip them. Trade-off (off by default; numbers measured on Forge 1.20.1): same results, but against the mod's own class (each path in its own JVM) a stealth check of a target with a modifier runs 0.963x (the six-attribute hook with one modifier 1.000x), while modifier-free hooks run 1.06-1.37x faster. Runtime flag puffishAttributesEmptyModifierFastPath. Helper bons.furious.patch.puffishattributes_coo49.PuffishLean.
